reuse.why: Extends the existing single getScheduledAmount used by every server and client consumer, and takes the tolerance from the rules module's getApproxNumberThreshold instead of recomputing 7.5%.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once inside getScheduledAmount; call sites only pass their operator.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts beside the range rule, with the tolerance owned by shared/rules.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and its callers; passing the operator in the list/table display sites also changes the amount shown and searched there, which goes slightly beyond planning.

maintainability.why: One definition for every path; the new op parameter is optional and placed before inverse, so a caller that forgets it silently gets the old exact-value behaviour.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, now given the operator by api-models, schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the desktop-client balance and schedule lists; useScheduleEdit's op-switch conversion keeps the default on purpose.
